title: hypericum humifusum var. liottardii
intro: Hypericum humifusum var. liottardii, commonly known as Creeping St. John's Wort, is a low-growing, woody perennial herb native to Europe and Asia. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in treating wounds, skin conditions, and minor infections. The therapeutic actions of Hypericum humifusum var. liottardii include its ability to promote wound healing, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include phenolic acids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
